hooks.command: content=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.new_string // .content // empty') && file_path=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty') && if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]] && echo "$content" | grep -q "from ['\"]@/lib/generated/prisma"; then echo 'BLOCKED: Never import from @/lib/generated/prisma. Use @/lib/prisma (server), @/lib/prisma-types (client), or @/lib/prisma-script (scripts).' >&2; exit 1; fi && if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]] && echo "$content" | grep -qE 'revalidateTag\([^,)]*\)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: revalidateTag requires 2 args (tag, cacheLife profile) — INC-13.' >&2; exit 1; fi && if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.ts$ && "$file_path" != *lib/prisma* && "$file_path" != *lib/generated* && "$file_path" != */scripts/* ]] && echo "$content" | grep -q 'new PrismaClient('; then echo 'BLOCKED: Module-scope PrismaClient — use the lazy Proxy in lib/prisma.ts (INC-07).' >&2; exit 1; fi

file_path=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty') && [ -n "$file_path" ] && [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css)$ ]] && npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true
